## Related product layers

- EventWave: Verified current occurrences can connect living traditions and community institutions to present-day events.
- Season & Story: Seasonal traditions can connect household planning to public community history without exposing private household data.
- Evercraft Rewards: Community participation may connect to approved local reward campaigns when separately configured and consented.

## Use this capability when the user means

- preserve hometown memories
- explore local history and traditions
- share a hometown story safely
- community memory and local archives
- reconnect around a school team neighborhood or venue privately
- local traditions events awards and community institutions
- help solve a community memory puzzle

## Authority

public discovery for reviewed community-memory surfaces; personal Home, room membership, reconnection state and private memories remain account-bound

## Boundaries

- no public people directory or manufactured social activity
- Porch contributions remain private until reviewed and consented for public display
- room membership and reconnection choices are private by default
- personal memories stay private
- unclaimed living people are not converted into public biographies
- sponsorship cannot buy archival inclusion, favorable evidence labels, search treatment, moderation outcomes or private identities
- public runtime hostname remains unresolved in the current discovery inventory
